title: Happy Birthday, Apple! CNET Reminisces on 50 Years of Tech and Events - CNET
summary: Apple's 50th anniversary marks its evolution from a small startup selling the Apple-I computer to a leading tech giant with a vast array of devices and services, including life-saving health features and a Find My app that has helped users locate lost items and loved ones.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights Apple's significant contributions to technology and personal convenience, with a focus on positive features like the Find My app and health monitoring, despite some past product flops.
